decisions.reason: This supplement line remains close to our existing consumer-health knowledge base and manufacturing capabilities, and after several years on the market our accumulated learning makes improvement more likely than withdrawal.
Although this joint-health supplement appears less central than the broader range, it still draws on related formulation and marketing knowledge that we can absorb and refine at relatively low risk.

The OTC migraine triptan is more distant from our established supplement-led launches, but as a large pharmaceutical firm with in-house development, regulatory, and production expertise we now have enough related knowledge to continue it while monitoring performance closely.
